name: HFS Research
description:
Bring HFS Research’s library of knowledge and research into your AI assistant. This connector gives authenticated HFS Research members conversational access to HFS’ published content. This content includes research reports, blogs, podcasts, videocasts, and quick takes. Ask questions and get cited answers drawn straight from HFS analysis.
What you can do: search across everything (semantic search returns the most relevant passages with source report, author, date, and link); filter by type (research, blogs, podcasts, videocasts, or quick takes); browse the latest; find by topic or author; and open a specific item by reference.
It is read-only. The MCP connector retrieves and cites HFS content and never posts, edits, or deletes anything. Access requires an eligible HFS Research membership; you sign in with your HFS account, and results reflect your entitlement. Every answer links back to the HFS Research site so you can read the full report.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HFS Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HFS Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hfsresearch.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HFS Research MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HFS Research provides these MCP tools: content_by_author, content_by_topic, get_content, recent_content, and search_content.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HFS Research?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HFS Research in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does HFS Research MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: HFS Research requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
HFS Research is developed by HFS Research Limited. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
